pages.title: Air on the Side
pages.text: Carry a Copper Backtank, Copper Diving Helmet and Copper Diving Boots.

pages.title: Air on the Side
pages.text: Prepare a workshop-supported diving outfit without a cannon-and-gadget shopping list.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Charge the backtank with rotation before diving and equip the three pieces. This preparation checks the three items; it does not pretend to prove an underwater expedition.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Backtank charges from rotation and works with eligible diving gear. Extendo Grip extends interactions under its native requirements; check charge/target rather than promise infinite reach.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Potato Cannon uses eligible food ammunition under its own rules and may use stored air; an actual projectile matters and it does not substitute exclusive boss weapons.
